field.name: custom_table
field.label: Customise Table layout

Add column headers/layouts and drag to reorder
Default is
. Date - {dowddmm}

field.name: pastwalks_routes_note
field.label: Item layout
field.description: Each item's look is defined once, globally, in Components > Ra_library > Options (Past Walks Layout / Routes Layout tabs) - there's no per-page override here. Every item links straight to its own single-item page automatically - nothing else needs setting up for that.

field.name: table_note
field.label: Table / Map and Table
field.description: Shows a fixed set of columns (Title, Date or Category, Grade, Distance) rather than the customisable item template used elsewhere - click a column heading to sort. Every title links to its single-item page. Map and Table also plots each item with a location as a marker; anything without one is listed separately underneath rather than left off.

field.name: categorytree_note

field.name: blog_title_full
field.label: Title above the full walks
field.description: Optional, for example Our Next Walks and Events. Leave blank for no title.

field.name: blog_title_panel
field.label: Title above the panels
field.description: Optional, for example Further Walks and Events. Leave blank for no title.

field.name: blog_title_links
field.label: Title above the links
field.description: Optional. Leave blank for no title.

field.name: blog_title_level
field.label: Title size
field.description: Heading level used for the three titles. Choose to suit the headings on the rest of your page.

field.name: blog_full_items
field.label: Number of full walks
field.description: Shown first, in full. 0 for none. Walks are taken in date order: full walks, then panels, then links.

field.name: blog_sections
field.label: Sections in each full walk
field.description: Select the sections you want and sort into order; deselect them all for the default order, which is Title, Photo, Description, Meeting, Start, Finish, Difficulty, Contact, Map, More

field.name: blog_full_map
field.label: Map in full walks
field.description: Used when the Map section is selected. A map only loads when asked for or when it scrolls into view, so several full walks do not slow the page.
field.option: Show automatically when scrolled into view

field.name: custom_blog_full
field.label: Customise full walk layout
field.description: Optional. Replaces the text sections (Title, Description, Meeting, Start, Finish, Difficulty, Contact) with your own layout. Photo, Map and More details still follow the section list.

field.name: blog_panel_items
field.label: Number of walks in the panel row
field.description: Shown after the full walks, each in a white panel. 0 for none.

field.name: blog_panel_mode
field.label: Panel layout
field.description: Flexible: as many panels as fit the width of the page, swipe or use the buttons for the rest. Fixed: a set number of columns, all panels shown, wrapping onto more rows.
field.option: Flexible - swipe row, number shown depends on page width

field.name: blog_panel_minwidth
field.label: Minimum panel width (px)
field.description: Flexible layout only. Larger values give fewer, wider panels.

field.name: blog_panel_columns
field.label: Number of columns
field.description: Fixed layout only. Reduces to 2 columns on narrow screens and 1 on phones.

field.name: blog_panel_image
field.label: Show photo in panel
field.description: Show the first photo of the walk, if it has one, at the top of the panel.

field.name: blog_photo_height
field.label: Photo height (px)
field.description: Height of the photo at the top of each panel. The photo keeps its shape and is cropped to fill the space.

field.name: blog_default_image
field.label: Picture for walks without a photo
field.description: Shown at the top of a panel when the walk has no photo of its own. Only used when 'Show photo in panel' is on.

field.name: blog_panel_fields
field.label: Items shown in each panel
field.description: Select the items you want and sort into order. Deselect them all for the default: Title, Date, Difficulty, Distance. Items a walk has no value for are left out. Ignored if you set your own panel layout below.

field.name: blog_panel_labels
field.label: Show item labels
field.description: Show a label before each item, for example Difficulty: Easy.

field.name: blog_panel_arrows
field.label: Previous / next buttons
field.description: Flexible layout only. Visitors can always swipe or scroll.

field.name: custom_blog_panel
field.label: Customise panel layout
field.description: Optional. If you fill this in it replaces the list of items above, and you have full control of the text in each panel.

field.name: blog_link_items
field.label: Number of links
field.description: Shown last, as a plain list of links that open the walk details. 0 for none.

field.name: custom_blog_links
field.label: Customise link layout
field.description: Default is {gradeimg}{dowddmm}{, ?title}{, ?distance}

field.name: routes_smartroutingnote
field.label: Smart Routing
field.description:
The option can also support a smart routing option. When enabled, this option follows the paths, roads, etc. as defined on OpenStreetMap. This is instead of drawing a straight line between points. To enable this option, which is highly recommended, you need to take out a license from OpenRouteService as below:

  • Visit https://openrouteservice.org/terms-of-service/ and review the terms and conditions.
  • If you are happy with these, sign up for an account at https://openrouteservice.org/dev/#/signup.
  • Then take out a key/token and copy and save that key below.
